title: Ayali
desc: Tamizhselvi, a young woman, aspires to become a doctor, but in the village of Veerappannai, oppressive traditions challenge her dreams.

title: Thothapuri: Chapter 1
desc: A Hindu tailor and a Muslim banker, both with a witty outlook on life, fall in love. However, their differing religious beliefs create problems, testing their bond.

title: Kaapa
desc: When Anand finds his pregnant wife's name on Kerala's anti-social list alongside other criminals, he sets on a determined mission to clear her name and prove her innocence.

title: Johnny Johnny Yes Papa
desc: Johnny, along with his father, works for social causes under the pretext of a software management firm. His life, however, takes a huge turn when he meets Priya and falls for her.
